The '''1938-39 Serie A''' was the thirty-ninth edition of the [[Italian Football Championship]] and its tenth since [[1929–30 Serie A|1929]] re-[[brand]]ing to create [[Serie A]]. It was the sixteenth season from which the Italian Football Champions adorned their team jerseys in the subsequent season with a [[Scudetto]]. [[Bologna F.C. 1909|Bologna]] were champions for the fifth time in their [[history]]. This was their fifth scudetto since the scudetto started being awarded in [[1923–24 Prima Divisione|1924]] and their third win contested as Serie A. This re-ignited the [[Internazionale|Ambrosiana-Inter]] punctuated run of four Bologna wins from six consecutive Serie A competitions until 1941.
[[Image:Serie A (football) 1938-39.png|thumb|325px|right|Serie A 1938-39 teams distribution]]

==Teams==
[[Novara Calcio|Novara]] and [[Modena FC|Modena]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].

==Events==
The [[goal average]] substituted the tie-breaker in event of equal points, to save time considering the risk of war. This change greatly helped [[US Triestina|Triestina]].
